name: Aife Foltfhind
text: Aife Foltfhind is the daughter of a king of Ulster in early Irish legend. Her name means Aife of the fair hair. The dictionary points the reader to the names Mongfind and Mong Ban. The fair mane in her name echoes her own. She is one of many women called Aife in the old tales.

attributes.attribute: daughter of a king of Ulster
name means Aife of the fair hair, echoed in Mong Ban

okr.objective: Record Aife Foltfhind, the fair-haired daughter of Ulster.
key_results: Give the meaning of her name.
Set the echo in Mong Ban.
